targets.authors: Plank, Barbara, Søgaard, Anders, and Goldberg, Yoav
targets.title: Multilingual Part-of-Speech Tagging with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Models and Auxiliary Loss.
targets.evidence_quote:
Our intention is to replicate the findings of
Plank et al. (2016), which have been achieved on a
coarse-grained tagset and investigate if they trans-
fer to fine-grained tagsets.
targets.outcome_quote:
Our replication confirms the result in gen-
eral, and we additionally find that the ad-
vantage of LSTMs is even bigger for larger
tagsets.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that their replication confirms the original result in general. Extensions concerning tagset size and specialized reference taggers do not overturn this verdict.

reasoning: Fresh evaluation corpora test Plank et al. (2016). Section 7 compares newly trained generic models against published language-specific tagger performance; those references are benchmarks rather than original findings whose own models are re-tested.
